inspectedHeadings: 精選版 日本国語大辞典: うじうぢ【氏】 [2] 接尾語 and 氏の語誌
日本大百科全書(ニッポニカ): 氏 うじ opening paragraph
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The Japanese dictionary explicitly distinguishes native うじ as a respectful surname suffix, with an attested 1825 example, and explains that this suffix receded as on-reading し took the same role in modern times. The encyclopedia explicitly illustrates 山田氏 with suffix reading うじ.
lookups.teachingDisposition: Use 山田氏 やまだうじ solely as a qualified older suffix example for metadata -うじ; contrast modern reporting やまだし. Do not infer this reading from the ordinary clan-name 源氏 げんじ or invent a new surname's pronunciation.
lookups.confidence: high for the documented suffix and qualification; not a frequency survey
lookups.extractionLimit: Digital Daijisen heading was present without extracted definition; the claim relies on the actually returned named dictionary/encyclopedia sections, not that empty heading. Other historical/etymological accounts on the aggregate page were not adopted.

lookups.disposition: Navigation only, not primary dictionary evidence.

inspectedHeadings: 乃: readings, numbered senses and word navigation
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The character entry explicitly lists ダイ/ナイ and すなわち/なんじ/の. Its numbered senses give a connecting function, a second-person gloss and phonetic use for の. The word navigation explicitly identifies 乃ち すなわ-ち, 乃公 ダイコウ and 乃 なんじ.
lookups.teachingDisposition: Use the character entry for the なんじ recognition gloss without inventing a conversational sentence. The separate on ノ/アイ entries remain KANJIDIC2-only here. JMdict's particle 乃 spelling is search-only; 乃ち is rare; 乃公 is dated, rough/arrogant male first person.
lookups.confidence: high for exact character senses/heading; register of 乃公 comes from the inspected complete JMdict family
lookups.extractionLimit: The dedicated 乃 なんじ word URL returned only copyright text. It supplies no additional definition evidence.

inspectedHeadings: 彗: on/kun, senses, radical image identifier and word navigation
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The entry lists スイ/ケイ/エ and the broom gloss ほうき; word navigation gives 彗星 スイセイ and 彗 ほうき. The displayed radical image was downloaded and visually inspected: a slanted 彐-like lower form. Its filename 57c.png is not evidence that the site assigns classical radical 57.
lookups.teachingDisposition: Keep KANJIDIC2 radical 58 and all four on readings unchanged. Locate the lower component without asserting a different dictionary index from an image filename. Do not allocate the 星 portion of すいせい to 彗's セイ. No compound example has been established here for エ/ケイ/セイ.
lookups.confidence: high for exact readings/headings and inspected glyph; no independent radical-number disagreement or historical structural classification asserted
lookups.authoringCorrection: An unreviewed draft inferred a different radical index from the site's image identifier. Actual glyph inspection did not establish that claim; it was removed before the frozen review snapshot.
